name: Zyle 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZYLE 100MG TABLET

ZYLE 100MG TABLET contains Allopurinol which belongs to a group of medicines called Enzyme inhibitors. It is used to gout, uric acid nephropathy, hyperuricemia, uric acid renal calculi and calcium oxalate renal calculi. Gout is a form of arthritis due to high levels of uric acid in the body and this uric acid builds up in the joints and tendons as crystals causing severe pain, redness and tenderness in joints.

Before taking ZYLE 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver problems, high blood pressure or heart problems, thyroid, cancer or Lesch-Nyhan syndrome, gout attack, lactose or galactose intolerance and glucose-galactose malabsorption. ZYLE 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it passes through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

ZYLE 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below children under 15 years of age except in some types of cancer such as leukaemia and certain enzyme disorders such as Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. ZYLE 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ZYLE 100MG TABLET are skin rash and increased levels of thyroid stimulation hormone in blood. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsens or doesn’t improve.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZYLE 100MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Gout
Uric acid nephropathy
Hyperuricemia
Uric acid renal calculi (prophylaxis)
Calcium oxalate renal calculi (prophylaxis)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYLE 100MG TABLET Works

ZYLE 100MG TABLET works by stopping the enzyme (xanthine oxidase) which is responsible for production of uric acid. Thus lowering the levels of uric acid in blood and urine and decreases the incidence of gout symptoms.
usageDetails:
How to use ZYLE 100MG TABLET

Take ZYLE 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Allergic reaction symptoms such as flaking skin, boils or sore lips and mouth, sudden wheeziness, fluttering or tightness in the chest and collapse

Serious hypersensitivity reactions characterized by fever, joint pain, abnormalities in blood, bleeding in the lips, mouth, eyes, nose or genitals, ulcers of the mouth, throat, nose, genitals, conjunctivitis (red and swollen eyes), widespread blisters or peeling

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ZYLE 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Aspirin (medicine used to manage heart diseases, pain)
Theophylline (medicine used for asthma and breathing disorders)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine)
Vidarabine (used to manage herpes simplex or chicken pox)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. ampicillin and amoxicillin)
Didanosine (used to manage HIV infection)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. chlorpropamide and tolbutamide)
Cytostatics (medicines stop the cell growth in cancer) Ex. cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, bleomycin, procarbazine, alkyl halogenides
Azathioprine (medicines used for rheumatoid arthritis and after organ transplants)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure, heart failure (Ex. captopril)
Medicines used to thin the blood (Ex. dicoumarol, phenprocoumon, warfarin)
Medicines used to reduce uric acid levels, gout (Ex. probenecid, salicylate)
Aluminum hydroxide (medicines used to manage acidity)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ZYLE 100MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea and dizziness.

name: Febustat 40mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About FEBUSTAT 40MG TABLET

FEBUSTAT 40MG TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take FEBUSTAT 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take FEBUSTAT 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. FEBUSTAT 40MG TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking FEBUSTAT 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking FEBUSTAT 40MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults

How FEBUSTAT 40MG TABLET Works

FEBUSTAT 40MG TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

name: FEBURIC 40mg Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About FEBURIC 40MG TABLET

Feburic 40mg tablet is a prescription medication formulated for managing elevated uric acid levels commonly associated with gout and related conditions. Gout is a form of arthritis caused by the buildup of uric acid crystals in the joints, leading to intense pain, swelling, and inflammation. Feburic contains febuxostat, a potent xanthine oxidase inhibitor that effectively reduces the production of uric acid in the body. This medication is particularly beneficial for adults who have not responded well to allopurinol or cannot take it due to intolerance or side effects.

Feburic 40mg is ideal for patients diagnosed with gout, hyperuricemia, or uric acid nephrolithiasis, and those at risk of tumour lysis syndrome due to rapid cell breakdown. It is typically taken once daily, with or without food, and should be swallowed whole with water. Consistency in dosing time and adherence to the prescribed regimen are essential for optimal control of uric acid levels and prevention of gout flare-ups. Patients are advised to maintain adequate hydration and follow lifestyle recommendations, such as a low-purine diet, to enhance treatment efficacy.

Before starting Feburic, patients should inform their healthcare provider about existing kidney, liver, or heart conditions and any allergies to febuxostat or allopurinol. This medication is not recommended for use during pregnancy or breastfeeding due to insufficient safety data. Patients should use caution when driving or operating machinery until they understand how Feburic affects them, as dizziness and drowsiness possible side effects. Regular monitoring of liver function and uric acid levels is recommended during therapy to detect adverse reactions early.

Common side effects of Feburic 40mg include nausea, dizziness, skin rash, headache, and gastrointestinal discomfort. More serious but rare adverse effects include liver problems, severe allergic reactions, or heart-related symptoms, which require immediate medical attention. Patients experiencing any unusual symptoms or side effects should contact their healthcare provider promptly. With proper use under medical supervision, Feburic 40mg can significantly improve quality of life by reducing gout attacks and managing uric acid levels effectively.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults

mechanismOfAction:
How FEBURIC 40MG TABLET Works
Feburic 40mg Tablet Mechanism

Feburic 40mg contains febuxostat, which works by selectively blocking the enzyme xanthine oxidase. This enzyme helps produce uric acid in the body. By inhibiting it, Feburic reduces uric acid levels in the blood, helping prevent the buildup of uric acid crystals that cause gout and related problems. This targeted action makes it effective for managing high uric acid and gout symptoms safely.
usageInstructions: Take one 40mg tablet of Feburic once daily, at the same time each day for best results.
You may take it with or without food according to your preference or doctor’s advice.
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
Continue taking the medication regularly even if you feel better to prevent gout attacks.
Your doctor may adjust your dose to 80mg once daily if uric acid levels are not adequately controlled after two weeks.
Avoid skipping doses; if you miss one, take it as soon as you remember unless it’s close to the next dose do not double dose.
Drink plenty of water daily to help reduce uric acid and support kidney health.
Regular blood tests may be necessary to monitor liver function and uric acid levels during treatment.
Consult your doctor immediately if you experience severe side effects or symptoms of liver issues.
Do not stop taking Feburic without consulting your healthcare provider, even if symptoms improve.

introduction:
Introduction About URICARE 100MG TABLET

URICARE 100MG TABLET contains Allopurinol which belongs to a group of medicines called Enzyme inhibitors. It is used to gout, uric acid nephropathy, hyperuricemia, uric acid renal calculi and calcium oxalate renal calculi. Gout is a form of arthritis due to high levels of uric acid in the body and this uric acid builds up in the joints and tendons as crystals causing severe pain, redness and tenderness in joints.

Before taking URICARE 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver problems, high blood pressure or heart problems, thyroid, cancer or Lesch-Nyhan syndrome, gout attack, lactose or galactose intolerance and glucose-galactose malabsorption. URICARE 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it passes through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

URICARE 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below children under 15 years of age except in some types of cancer such as leukaemia and certain enzyme disorders such as Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. URICARE 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking URICARE 100MG TABLET are skin rash and increased levels of thyroid stimulation hormone in blood. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsens or doesn’t improve.

introduction:
Introduction About FEBUTAZ 40 TABLET

FEBUTAZ 40 Tablet contains Febuxostat 40 mg medication primarily used to support the management of elevated uric acid levels in adults. Elevated uric acid can arise due to metabolic imbalances and FEBUTAZ helps by modulating the enzyme responsible for uric acid production, thereby assisting in maintaining balanced serum uric acid levels. This makes it a suitable option for adults who require ongoing support for uric acid regulation, especially when lifestyle measures alone do not achieve the desired balance.    

This medication is ideal for adults diagnosed with persistent hyperuricemia, particularly those who need to regulate uric acid levels under medical guidance. FEBUTAZ works by inhibiting xanthine oxidase, an enzyme involved in the production of uric acid, helping to maintain healthier uric acid levels over time.   

It is typically taken once daily with or without food as advised by a healthcare professional. Consistent use as per the prescribed schedule is important for optimal support. 

When using FEBUTAZ 40, patients should adhere strictly to the dosage instructions provided by their healthcare provider. It is important to inform your doctor about any other medications you are taking to avoid potential interactions. Certain precautions include avoiding use during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless explicitly recommended by a physician. Patients with liver or kidney concerns should be monitored closely while using this medication. The common side effects may include mild stomach discomfort, nausea, or headache, which generally resolve without needing to stop the medication.
uses: Helps in the management of elevated uric acid levels in adults (in conditions like chronic hyperuricemia)
usesDetails:
Uses Of FEBUTAZ 40 TABLET
Helps in the management of elevated uric acid levels in adults (in conditions like chronic hyperuricemia)
mechanismOfAction:
How FEBUTAZ 40 TABLET Works

FEBUTAZ 40 helps manage high uric acid levels in the body. It works by blocking an enzyme called xanthine oxidase. This enzyme is responsible for turning certain natural substances (called purines) into uric acid.

When xanthine oxidase is active more uric acid gets produced. FEBUTAZ slows down this enzyme, which helps reduce the amount of uric acid formed in the blood. As a result, uric acid levels can stay within a healthier range over time.

By helping to control how much uric acid the body makes, FEBUTAZ supports better metabolic balance and can be an important part of a long-term plan for individuals dealing with high uric acid concerns.

name: Febutaz 20mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About FEBUTAZ 20MG TABLET

FEBUTAZ 20MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking FEBUTAZ 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. FEBUTAZ 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. FEBUTAZ 20MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking FEBUTAZ 20MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
usesDetails:
Uses Of FEBUTAZ 20MG TABLET
Manage gout
Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
mechanismOfAction:
How FEBUTAZ 20MG TABLET Works

FEBUTAZ 20MG TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.

How to use FEBUTAZ 20MG TABLET

Take FEBUTAZ 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow FEBUTAZ 20MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight.

introduction:
Introduction About FEBUFIX 40MG TABLET

FEBUFIX 40MG TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take FEBUFIX 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take FEBUFIX 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. FEBUFIX 40MG TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking FEBUFIX 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking FEBUFIX 40MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults

How FEBUFIX 40MG TABLET Works

FEBUFIX 40MG TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

introduction:
Introduction About ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 40 TABLET

ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 40 TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 40 TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 40 TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 40 TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About EBUXO 80MG TABLET

EBUXO 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking EBUXO 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. EBUXO 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. EBUXO 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking EBUXO 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood

Manage gout
Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
mechanismOfAction:
How EBUXO 80MG TABLET Works

EBUXO 80MG TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.

Take EBUXO 80MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow EBUXO 80MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight.

name: Febustat 80Mg Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About FEBUSTAT 80MG TABLET

FEBUSTAT 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking FEBUSTAT 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. FEBUSTAT 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. FEBUSTAT 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking FEBUSTAT 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
usesDetails:
Uses Of FEBUSTAT 80MG TABLET
Manage gout
Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
mechanismOfAction:
How FEBUSTAT 80MG TABLET Works

FEBUSTAT 80MG TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.
usageDetails:
How to use FEBUSTAT 80MG TABLET

Take FEBUSTAT 80MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow FEBUSTAT 80MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight.

name: Febucip 40mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET

FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET
Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET Works

FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

Take FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking FEBUCIP 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have high uric acid levels as a result of Lesch-Nyhan syndrome (a rare inherited condition in which there is too much uric acid in the blood)
Have thyroid problems

introduction:
Introduction About FEBUTAZ 80MG TABLET

FEBUTAZ 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking FEBUTAZ 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. FEBUTAZ 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. FEBUTAZ 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking FEBUTAZ 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood

Manage gout

mechanismOfAction:
How FEBUTAZ 80MG TABLET Works

FEBUTAZ 80MG TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.

Take FEBUTAZ 80MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow FEBUTAZ 80MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight.

introduction:
Introduction About ZURIG 40MG TABLET

ZURIG 40MG TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take ZURIG 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take ZURIG 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. ZURIG 40MG TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking ZURIG 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking ZURIG 40MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

How ZURIG 40MG TABLET Works

By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

introduction:
Introduction About FEBUMAC 40MG TABLET

FEBUMAC 40MG TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take FEBUMAC 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take FEBUMAC 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. FEBUMAC 40MG TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking FEBUMAC 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking FEBUMAC 40MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
usesDetails:

Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How FEBUMAC 40MG TABLET Works

FEBUMAC 40MG TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

introduction:
Introduction About ZYRIK 300MG TABLET

ZYRIK 300MG TABLET contains Allopurinol which belongs to a group of medicines called Enzyme inhibitors. It is used to manage gout, kidney stones, enzyme disorders (Lesch-Nyhan Syndrome), and high levels of uric acid caused by certain cancer medications.

Gout is a form of arthritis due to high levels of uric acid in the body and this uric acid builds up in the joints and tendons as crystals causing severe pain, redness and tenderness in joints.

Before taking ZYRIK 300MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver problems, high blood pressure or heart problems, thyroid, cancer or Lesch-Nyhan syndrome, gout attack, lactose or galactose intolerance and glucose-galactose malabsorption.

ZYRIK 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it passes through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

ZYRIK 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below children under 15 years of age except in some types of cancer such as leukaemia and certain enzyme disorders such as Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. ZYRIK 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking ZYRIK 300MG TABLET are skin rash and increased levels of thyroid stimulation hormone in blood. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsens or doesn’t improve.

ZYRIK 300MG TABLET works by stopping the enzyme (xanthine oxidase) which is responsible for production of uric acid. Thus lowering the levels of uric acid in blood and urine and decreases the incidence of gout symptoms.

name: FBT 40 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About FBT 40 TABLET

FBT 40 TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take FBT 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take FBT 40 TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. FBT 40 TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking FBT 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking FBT 40 TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults

Uses Of FBT 40 TABLET
Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How FBT 40 TABLET Works

FBT 40 TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

Take FBT 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based on your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking FBT 40 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

It is not known whether febuxostat could pass through the breast milk. Therefore, do not take FBT 40 TABLET if you are breastfeeding without medical advice.

Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience blurred vision, dizziness, sleepiness or any other side effects that can affect your ability to concentrate while undergoing therapy with FBT 40 TABLET.
FBT 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
FBT 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
Do not take FBT 40 TABLET if you are allergic to Febuxostat or allopurinol.
FBT 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as heart failure). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
FBT 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking FBT 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have high uric acid levels as a result of Lesch-Nyhan syndrome (a rare inherited condition in which there is too much uric acid in the blood)
Have thyroid problems

name: FEBUTEC 80 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About FEBUTEC 80 TABLET

FEBUTEC 80 TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking FEBUTEC 80 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. FEBUTEC 80 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. FEBUTEC 80 TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking FEBUTEC 80 TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
usesDetails:
Uses Of FEBUTEC 80 TABLET
Manage gout
Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
mechanismOfAction:
How FEBUTEC 80 TABLET Works

FEBUTEC 80 TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.
usageDetails:
How to use FEBUTEC 80 TABLET

Take FEBUTEC 80 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow FEBUTEC 80 TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight.

name: ALLORIX 100 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ALLORIX 100 TABLET

ALLORIX 100 TABLET contains Allopurinol which belongs to a group of medicines called Enzyme inhibitors. It is used to gout, uric acid nephropathy, hyperuricemia, uric acid renal calculi and calcium oxalate renal calculi. Gout is a form of arthritis due to high levels of uric acid in the body and this uric acid builds up in the joints and tendons as crystals causing severe pain, redness and tenderness in joints.

Before taking ALLORIX 100 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver problems, high blood pressure or heart problems, thyroid, cancer or Lesch-Nyhan syndrome, gout attack, lactose or galactose intolerance and glucose-galactose malabsorption. ALLORIX 100 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it passes through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

ALLORIX 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in children below children under 15 years of age except in some types of cancer such as leukaemia and certain enzyme disorders such as Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. ALLORIX 100 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ALLORIX 100 TABLET are skin rash and increased levels of thyroid stimulation hormone in blood. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsens or doesn’t improve.

How ALLORIX 100 TABLET Works

ALLORIX 100 TABLET works by stopping the enzyme (xanthine oxidase) which is responsible for production of uric acid. Thus lowering the levels of uric acid in blood and urine and decreases the incidence of gout symptoms.

Take ALLORIX 100 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Segera ER 40mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SEGERA ER 40MG TABLET

SEGERA ER 40MG TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take SEGERA ER 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take SEGERA ER 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. SEGERA ER 40MG TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking SEGERA ER 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking SEGERA ER 40MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of SEGERA ER 40MG TABLET
Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How SEGERA ER 40MG TABLET Works

SEGERA ER 40MG TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

Take SEGERA ER 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

name: Zyrik 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZYRIK 100MG TABLET

ZYRIK 100MG TABLET contains Allopurinol which belongs to a group of medicines called Enzyme inhibitors. It is used to gout, uric acid nephropathy, hyperuricemia, uric acid renal calculi and calcium oxalate renal calculi. Gout is a form of arthritis due to high levels of uric acid in the body and this uric acid builds up in the joints and tendons as crystals causing severe pain, redness and tenderness in joints.

Before taking ZYRIK 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver problems, high blood pressure or heart problems, thyroid, cancer or Lesch-Nyhan syndrome, gout attack, lactose or galactose intolerance and glucose-galactose malabsorption. ZYRIK 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it passes through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

ZYRIK 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below children under 15 years of age except in some types of cancer such as leukaemia and certain enzyme disorders such as Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. ZYRIK 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ZYRIK 100MG TABLET are skin rash and increased levels of thyroid stimulation hormone in blood. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsens or doesn’t improve.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZYRIK 100MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Gout
Uric acid nephropathy
Hyperuricemia
Uric acid renal calculi (prophylaxis)
Calcium oxalate renal calculi (prophylaxis)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYRIK 100MG TABLET Works

ZYRIK 100MG TABLET works by stopping the enzyme (xanthine oxidase) which is responsible for production of uric acid. Thus lowering the levels of uric acid in blood and urine and decreases the incidence of gout symptoms.

Take ZYRIK 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: FEBUDIM ER 40 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET

FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET
Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET Works

FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

Take FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

Others

Before taking FEBUDIM ER 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have thyroid problems

introduction:
Introduction About FOXSTAT 80MG TABLET

FOXSTAT 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking FOXSTAT 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. FOXSTAT 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. FOXSTAT 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking FOXSTAT 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.

How FOXSTAT 80MG TABLET Works

FOXSTAT 80MG TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.

introduction:
Introduction About FEBUDAY 80MG TABLET

FEBUDAY 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking FEBUDAY 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. FEBUDAY 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. FEBUDAY 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking FEBUDAY 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.

How FEBUDAY 80MG TABLET Works

FEBUDAY 80MG TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.

Take FEBUDAY 80MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow FEBUDAY 80MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight.

introduction:
Introduction About ZYLE 300MG TABLET

ZYLE 300MG TABLET contains Allopurinol which belongs to a group of medicines called Enzyme inhibitors. It is used to manage gout, kidney stones, enzyme disorders (Lesch-Nyhan Syndrome), and high levels of uric acid caused by certain cancer medications.

Gout is a form of arthritis due to high levels of uric acid in the body and this uric acid builds up in the joints and tendons as crystals causing severe pain, redness and tenderness in joints.

Before taking ZYLE 300MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver problems, high blood pressure or heart problems, thyroid, cancer or Lesch-Nyhan syndrome, gout attack, lactose or galactose intolerance and glucose-galactose malabsorption.

ZYLE 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it passes through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

ZYLE 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below children under 15 years of age except in some types of cancer such as leukaemia and certain enzyme disorders such as Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. ZYLE 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking ZYLE 300MG TABLET are skin rash and increased levels of thyroid stimulation hormone in blood. Consult with your doctor if any of these worsens or doesn’t improve.

name: URILESS 40 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About URILESS 40 TABLET

URILESS 40 TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take URILESS 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take URILESS 40 TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. URILESS 40 TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking URILESS 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking URILESS 40 TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of URILESS 40 TABLET
Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How URILESS 40 TABLET Works

URILESS 40 TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.
usageDetails:
How to use URILESS 40 TABLET

Take URILESS 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based on your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking URILESS 40 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

It is not known whether febuxostat could pass through the breast milk. Therefore, do not take URILESS 40 TABLET if you are breastfeeding without medical advice.

Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience blurred vision, dizziness, sleepiness or any other side effects that can affect your ability to concentrate while undergoing therapy with URILESS 40 TABLET.
URILESS 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
URILESS 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
Do not take URILESS 40 TABLET if you are allergic to Febuxostat or allopurinol.
URILESS 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as heart failure). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
URILESS 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking URILESS 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have high uric acid levels as a result of Lesch-Nyhan syndrome (a rare inherited condition in which there is too much uric acid in the blood)
Have thyroid problems

name: GOUTFREE 40 XL Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About GOUTFREE 40 XL TABLET

GOUTFREE 40 XL TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take GOUTFREE 40 XL TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take GOUTFREE 40 XL TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. GOUTFREE 40 XL TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking GOUTFREE 40 XL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking GOUTFREE 40 XL TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults

How GOUTFREE 40 XL TABLET Works

GOUTFREE 40 XL TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

introduction:
Introduction About FEBUDAC 80MG TABLET

FEBUDAC 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking FEBUDAC 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. FEBUDAC 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. FEBUDAC 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking FEBUDAC 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood

Manage gout
Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
mechanismOfAction:
How FEBUDAC 80MG TABLET Works

FEBUDAC 80MG TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.

Take FEBUDAC 80MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow FEBUDAC 80MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight.

name: LEFUTOID 10mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About LEFUTOID 10MG TABLET

LEFUTOID 10MG TABLET contains Leflunomide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-rheumatics. It is used for the management of active rheumatoid arthritis or with active psoriatic arthritis. Rheumatoid arthritis is an auto-immune chronic inflammatory disorder which affects many joints including those in the hands and feet. Symptoms include inflammation of joints, swelling, difficulty moving and pain, loss of appetite, fever, loss of energy and anaemia (lack of red blood cells). Active psoriatic arthritis refers to a condition where psoriasis, a skin condition is present along with arthritis. Symptoms include inflammation of joints, swelling, difficulty in moving, pain and patches of red and scaly skin (skin lesions).

Before starting management with LEFUTOID 10MG TABLET, your doctor might ask you to take a few blood tests to understand the existing condition and to use this medicine safely. LEFUTOID 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having liver or moderate to severe kidney disease, any problem which affects the immune system (like AIDS), bone marrow problems, serious infections, severely low levels of proteins in the blood (hypoproteinaemia) and reduced levels of white or red blood cells and platelet count. LEFUTOID 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have interstitial lung disease, tuberculosis or if you are a male who wishes to father a child and chronic diarrhoea. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine as it may increase the risk of liver damage.

LEFUTOID 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women who become pregnant during management with this medicine and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LEFUTOID 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking LEFUTOID 10MG TABLET are loss of appetite, tiredness, headache, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, inflammation of the mouth or mouth ulcers, abdominal pain and increased hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How LEFUTOID 10MG TABLET Works

LEFUTOID 10MG TABLET acts by inhibiting an enzyme which results in stopping the activated and autoimmune white blood cells. This inhibition leads to anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects, reducing inflammation due to arthritis.

Take LEFUTOID 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Serious allergic reaction (signs include weakness, light-headedness or dizziness or have difficulty breathing)

Blood disorders (signs include pale skin, tiredness, bruising)
Signs of liver failure (signs include tiredness, abdominal pain and jaundice)
Signs of infection (signs include cough, fever and sore throat)
Coughing or breathing problems (signs include interstitial lung disease or pulmonary hypertension)
Signs of peripheral neuropathy (unusual tingling, weakness or pain in the hands or feet)

name: UBEXA 80 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About UBEXA 80 TABLET

UBEXA 80 TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking UBEXA 80 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. UBEXA 80 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. UBEXA 80 TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking UBEXA 80 TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
usesDetails:
Uses Of UBEXA 80 TABLET
Manage gout
Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
mechanismOfAction:
How UBEXA 80 TABLET Works

UBEXA 80 TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.
usageDetails:
How to use UBEXA 80 TABLET

Take UBEXA 80 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow UBEXA 80 TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight.

introduction:
Introduction About ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 80MG TABLET

ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood

Manage gout
Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
mechanismOfAction:
How ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 80MG TABLET Works

ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 80MG TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.

Take ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 80MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow ENDEAVOUR's FURIC 80MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight.

name: FEBS 40 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About FEBS 40 TABLET

FEBS 40 TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take FEBS 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take FEBS 40 TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. FEBS 40 TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking FEBS 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking FEBS 40 TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of FEBS 40 TABLET
Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How FEBS 40 TABLET Works

FEBS 40 TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.
usageDetails:
How to use FEBS 40 TABLET

Take FEBS 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based on your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking FEBS 40 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience blurred vision, dizziness, sleepiness or any other side effects that can affect your ability to concentrate while undergoing therapy with FEBS 40 TABLET.
FEBS 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
FEBS 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

FEBS 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as heart failure). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
FEBS 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Have high uric acid levels as a result of Lesch-Nyhan syndrome (a rare inherited condition in which there is too much uric acid in the blood)
Have thyroid problems

introduction:
Introduction About FEBULIFE 40 TABLET

FEBULIFE 40 TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take FEBULIFE 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take FEBULIFE 40 TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. FEBULIFE 40 TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking FEBULIFE 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking FEBULIFE 40 TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

How FEBULIFE 40 TABLET Works

This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

Introduction About FEBUXOR 80MG TABLET

FEBUXOR 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking FEBUXOR 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. FEBUXOR 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. FEBUXOR 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking FEBUXOR 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.

This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.

name: Febucip 80mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About FEBUCIP 80MG TABLET

FEBUCIP 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking FEBUCIP 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. FEBUCIP 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. FEBUCIP 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking FEBUCIP 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
usesDetails:
Uses Of FEBUCIP 80MG TABLET
Manage gout
Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
mechanismOfAction:
How FEBUCIP 80MG TABLET Works

FEBUCIP 80MG TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.
usageDetails:
How to use FEBUCIP 80MG TABLET

Take FEBUCIP 80MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow FEBUCIP 80MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight.

introduction:
Introduction About FEBUMAC 80MG TABLET

FEBUMAC 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking FEBUMAC 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. FEBUMAC 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. FEBUMAC 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking FEBUMAC 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood

Manage gout

mechanismOfAction:
How FEBUMAC 80MG TABLET Works

FEBUMAC 80MG TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.

Take FEBUMAC 80MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow FEBUMAC 80MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight.

name: FEXOSTAT 40 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About FEXOSTAT 40 TABLET

FEXOSTAT 40 TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take FEXOSTAT 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take FEXOSTAT 40 TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. FEXOSTAT 40 TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking FEXOSTAT 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking FEXOSTAT 40 TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
usesDetails:

Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How FEXOSTAT 40 TABLET Works

FEXOSTAT 40 TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.
