Take FEXOSTAT 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About FEBUXOT 80MG TABLET

FEBUXOT 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking FEBUXOT 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. FEBUXOT 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. FEBUXOT 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking FEBUXOT 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.

name: FEBUTHAL 40 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About FEBUTHAL 40 TABLET

FEBUTHAL 40 TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take FEBUTHAL 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take FEBUTHAL 40 TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. FEBUTHAL 40 TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking FEBUTHAL 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking FEBUTHAL 40 TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of FEBUTHAL 40 TABLET
Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How FEBUTHAL 40 TABLET Works

FEBUTHAL 40 TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

Take FEBUTHAL 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based on your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking FEBUTHAL 40 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

name: LEFUTOID 20mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About LEFUTOID 20MG TABLET

LEFUTOID 20MG TABLET contains Leflunomide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-rheumatics. It is indicated in adults for the management of active rheumatoid arthritis. Rheumatoid arthritis is an auto-immune chronic inflammatory disorder which affects many joints including those in the hands and feet. Symptoms include inflammation of joints, swelling, difficulty moving and pain, loss of appetite, fever, loss of energy and anaemia (lack of red blood cells).

LEFUTOID 20MG TABLET is also used in adults to manage active psoriatic arthritis. Active psoriatic arthritis refers to a condition where psoriasis, a skin condition is present along with arthritis. Symptoms include inflammation of joints, swelling, difficulty in moving, pain and patches of red and scaly skin (skin lesions).

Before starting management with LEFUTOID 20MG TABLET, your doctor might ask you to take a few blood tests to understand the existing condition and to use this medicine safely.  

LEFUTOID 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having liver or moderate to severe kidney disease, any problem which affects the immune system (like AIDS), bone marrow problems, serious infections, severely low levels of proteins in the blood (hypoproteinaemia) and reduced levels of white or red blood cells and platelet count.

LEFUTOID 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have interstitial lung disease, tuberculosis and if you are a male who wishes to father a child and chronic diarrhoea. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with this medicine as it may increase the risk of liver damage.

LEFUTOID 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women who become pregnant during management with this medicine and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LEFUTOID 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking LEFUTOID 20MG TABLET are loss of appetite, tiredness, headache, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, inflammation of the mouth or mouth ulcers, abdominal pain and increased hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How LEFUTOID 20MG TABLET Works

LEFUTOID 20MG TABLET acts by inhibiting an enzyme which results in stopping the activated and autoimmune white blood cells. This inhibition leads to anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects, reducing inflammation due to arthritis.

Take LEFUTOID 20MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FBT 80 TABLET

FBT 80 TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking FBT 80 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. FBT 80 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. FBT 80 TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking FBT 80 TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood

Manage gout

mechanismOfAction:
How FBT 80 TABLET Works

FBT 80 TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.

introduction:
Introduction About SEBUXO 40MG TABLET

SEBUXO 40MG TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take SEBUXO 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take SEBUXO 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. SEBUXO 40MG TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking SEBUXO 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking SEBUXO 40MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults

Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How SEBUXO 40MG TABLET Works

SEBUXO 40MG TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

introduction:
Introduction About FABULON 40MG TABLET

FABULON 40MG TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take FABULON 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take FABULON 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. FABULON 40MG TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking FABULON 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking FABULON 40MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
usesDetails:

Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How FABULON 40MG TABLET Works

FABULON 40MG TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.
usageDetails:

Take FABULON 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based on your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking FABULON 40MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About BUXORIC 80MG TABLET

BUXORIC 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking BUXORIC 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. BUXORIC 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. BUXORIC 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking BUXORIC 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood

Manage gout

BUXORIC 80MG TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.

name: Zurig 80mg Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZURIG 80MG TABLET

ZURIG 80MG TABLET contains Febuxostat, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antigout agents. It is used in the management of gout (common and complex form of arthritis that occurs when too much uric acid crystallises and deposits in the joints, resulting in sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in one or more joints, most often in the big toe). It is also used to manage accumulation of high blood levels of uric acid in the blood.

Before taking ZURIG 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, heart, thyroid problems and undergoing management for Lesch-Nyhan syndrome. ZURIG 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children, and adolescents. ZURIG 80MG TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The common side effects of taking ZURIG 80MG TABLET are abnormal liver test results, diarrhoea, headache, rash, nausea, increase in gout symptoms, localized swelling due to retention of fluids in tissues (oedema). Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms gets worse.
uses: Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZURIG 80MG TABLET
Manage gout
Prevents accumulation of high uric acid levels in the blood
mechanismOfAction:
How ZURIG 80MG TABLET Works

ZURIG 80MG TABLET works by blocking the action of enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which is involved in the process of converting hypoxanthine into uric acid (purine metabolism pathway). This type of action reduces high uric acid level in gout and blood cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy management.
usageDetails:
How to use ZURIG 80MG TABLET

Take ZURIG 80MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow ZURIG 80MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight.

name: Fubra 40mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About FUBRA 40MG TABLET

FUBRA 40MG TABLET is used in the management of gout which is associated with an excess of a chemical called uric acid in the body. It contains a medicine called Febuxostat which is used to lower uric acid levels in patients with gout. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body.

Take FUBRA 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During the initial days of the therapy, febuxostat can cause flare up of gout attacks in some individuals which is normal. Over the period of use, these flare ups usually reduce and becomes less painful upon everyday usage. If these flare ups are not manageable, consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take FUBRA 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to febuxostat, allopurinol and have an active gout attack. FUBRA 40MG TABLET should be used only when the gout attack subsides completely.

Before taking FUBRA 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart diseases or thyroid problems. The most common side effects of taking FUBRA 40MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, flare ups if gout attack, edema and abnormal liver test results. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of FUBRA 40MG TABLET
Management of gout and hyperuricemia (increased uric acid levels in the body) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How FUBRA 40MG TABLET Works

FUBRA 40MG TABLET works by selectively inhibiting an enzyme called xanthine oxidase, which plays a key role in the production of uric acid in the body. By blocking this enzyme, febuxostat reduces the formation of uric acid, thereby lowering its levels in the blood. This helps reducing the formation of uric acid crystals, which can cause painful gout attacks and joint damage.

Take FUBRA 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
